channel.title: Utrecht Beslist — City Council Decisions (Governance & Finance)
channel.description: Utrecht city council decisions and documents explained in plain language.

item.title: Annual Reports 2025
item.description: This council proposal is about the annual reports for 2025, concerning the financial reports of the municipality.

item.title: Result Destination 2025

item.description: This council proposal is about the multi-year spatial perspective for 2026, concerning the spatial development of the municipality.

item.title: Adopt Voorjaarsnota 2026
item.description: The council is deciding to adopt the policy-light Voorjaarsnota 2026. The document gives an up-to-date financial picture with unavoidable developments and bottlenecks. It contains no policy choices because it was drawn up before the elections.

item.title: Exemption of residence requirement
item.description: The city council discusses a proposal to exempt the residence requirement for aldermen. This means that someone who does not live in Utrecht can still become an alderman.

item.title: Exemption of residence requirement
item.description: The city council discusses a proposal to exempt the residence requirement for aldermen.

item.title: Appointment of Aldermen
item.description: The city council discusses the appointment of new aldermen.

item.title: Governance change for BghU tax cooperation
item.description: The college requests permission from the Gemeenteraad to amend the Gemeenschappelijke Regeling BghU. This changes BghU from an operational organization into a public body with an Algemeen Bestuur and Dagelijks Bestuur.

item.title: Draft Specific Statement of No Objections
item.description: The college proposes to adopt a draft Specific Statement of No Objections for Isotopenweg 29.

item.title: Governance change for BghU tax cooperation
item.description: The college requests permission from the Gemeenteraad to amend the Gemeenschappelijke Regeling BghU. This changes BghU from an operational organization into a public body with an Algemeen Bestuur and Dagelijks Bestuur.

item.title: First Management Report 2026
item.description: The First Management Report 2026 informs council on program budget progress. Increases of investment credits by 26.2 million euros and social domain reforms are proposed.

item.title: Annual Accounts 2025
item.description: The college presents the Annual Accounts 2025 accounting for policy and municipal finances. The year concludes with a positive result of 54.6 million euros added to the general coverage reserve.

item.title: Answers to council questions and financial document errata
item.description: The college sends responses to written questions regarding the Annual Accounts 2025 and management reports, including errata. The letter also contains a call from G4 cities regarding animal welfare and vet costs.

item.title: Result Allocation 2025
item.description: The college proposes carrying over 20.5 million euros in remaining incidental budgets from the Annual Accounts 2025 to 2026 to complete ongoing projects and programs.
